title: Weblotery Turbo
subtitle: Brute-force search for Bitcoin addresses, compiled to WebAssembly and run on your own browser's cores.
meta_description: Search for the private key of a Bitcoin address straight in the browser, with WebAssembly running across multiple cores. Nothing leaves your machine.

config.heading: Configuration
config.presets_hint: All 160 wallets of the 1000 BTC puzzle. The solved ones have had their key published, and are the only ones a search can finish on.
